costume.name: Linen Ghost
costume.description: An off-white linen drape over a light base outfit, finished with brown lace-up boots.
costume.alt: Linen Ghost: off-white linen sheet to drape, comfortable light base top, comfortable light base pants, brown leather lace-up boots, optional shawl pin or drape fastener, arranged on pale grey.

pieces.name: Off-white linen sheet to drape
pieces.styleNotes: A large, loose-woven off-white linen sheet with a slightly rumpled, aged texture that drapes in soft folds to the ankle. Vintage flax or stonewashed linen gives a classic, spooky storybook ghost look.
queries: vintage off-white linen bed sheet flax Etsy
handmade stonewashed natural linen flat sheet king size ivory
antique European hemp linen sheet cream undyed

matches.reason: Natural undyed unbleached flax linen. Twin measures 72 x 102 inches; selected Twin is $105.60. Other sheet sizes cost more. Real linen sheet requires DIY draping and openings.
100% stonewashed linen; white rather than cream. Current variant feed confirms White Queen in stock at $64.99. Larger white sizes are not available. Requires DIY draping and openings.
Off-white, heavyweight homespun-textured 100% flax linen. Selected twin is $202; larger sizes cost more.

pieces.name: Comfortable light base top
pieces.styleNotes: A lightweight, breathable cotton or linen tee or long-sleeve in white or cream, worn underneath the sheet. Keep it slim and plain so it doesn't bulk up the drape.
queries: handmade organic cotton long sleeve tee cream lightweight
vintage 90s plain white cotton t-shirt single stitch
small brand linen blend crew neck top off-white

matches.reason: Undyed natural, 4.3 oz organic cotton jersey; plain slim base layer. USA-grown cotton, sewn in Bay Area, per merchant.

Plain natural 100% US cotton crew tee. Current merchant feed lists $3.56 for S–XL; 2XL costs $4.80 and 3XL–5XL cost $5.45. Built-in web result had an older $2.88 price; live variant feed takes precedence. One shirt, no minimum pack shown.

Off-white 100% cotton, 6.5 oz garment-dyed unisex crew. More substantial than the brief’s lightweight tee, but color and plain cut fit. Exact selected-variant JSON verified for XS–2XL at $26; 3XL in stock at $28. Shopify .js returns only first 250 variants, omitting Off White, so selected-page variant JSON is the stock evidence.

pieces.name: Comfortable light base pants
pieces.styleNotes: Light, relaxed pants in cream, white or pale grey cotton or linen that stay hidden beneath the sheet. A drawstring waist keeps them comfortable all night.
queries: handmade linen drawstring pants natural off-white
vintage cotton drawstring trousers cream lightweight
small brand organic cotton lounge pants ecru

matches.reason: White 100% linen with drawstring waist. Merchant feed marks XS through XL available at $138.

White 100% European flax linen, relaxed fit and elastic waist, women’s sizing. Exact JSON-LD variants show XS, L, XL in stock; S and M are sold out. Selected L is $42. Useful hidden layer; lower price does not imply lower linen content.
Undyed natural organic cotton jersey, straight leg and elastic waistband. No drawstring. Hidden base layer; an upgrade here does not change the visible costume much.

pieces.name: Brown leather lace-up boots
pieces.styleNotes: Worn, brown leather lace-up boots with a rounded toe and a low stacked heel, in a vintage work or Victorian style. Scuffed, patinated leather adds to the haunted look peeking out from under the hem.
queries: vintage brown leather lace-up boots women's Victorian style
handmade brown leather lace up ankle boots Etsy
vintage men's brown leather work boots lace-up distressed

matches.reason: Saddle tan vegetable-tanned leather plain-toe lace-up. Leather construction and patina potential are merchant facts; higher price does not prove a better costume match. Standard D width listed here.

Live direct merchant HTML confirms Brown CH style 85088-215, $89.95, and sizes 7–14 displayed In Stock. Genuine crazy-horse/tumbled leather PLUS man-made upper, not full leather. Brown lace-up rounded plain toe suits hem reveal; lug wedge sole is more modern than Victorian. Medium and wide offered; width-specific availability must be selected before purchase. Built-in web fetch redirect was unreliable; direct merchant HTML was successfully read.
Brown leather lace-up cap-toe, low heel, studded sole. New boots; do not describe as vintage or already scuffed. Selected standard width, all listed sizes available at $199.

pieces.name: Optional shawl pin or drape fastener
pieces.styleNotes: A small antique-style brass or pewter shawl pin, brooch or kilt pin that secures the sheet at the shoulder or chin without showing much. A tarnished vintage finish suits the ghostly theme.
queries: vintage brass shawl pin brooch antique
handmade pewter cloak pin fastener Etsy
antique silver kilt pin large safety pin brooch

matches.reason: White-brass Jul Designs round shawl pin, 2-inch ring and 4-inch stick. Metal supports antique look; merchant does not call it pewter.
Single 3-inch silver-tone nickel kilt pin, $0.99; direct merchant variant feed marks available. Practical discreet fastener; not antique brass or pewter. Pins can leave holes in linen.
Antique-brass kilt pin, 3 x 3/4 inches, specifically sold for shawls and kilts. Current Shopify variant marks available at $22. No functional claim that it holds better than the $0.99 pin.
